verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails, or any ORM or framework integration guide. It only says Neon is Postgres and can be reached with generic Postgres clients (psql, dbeaver) or its serverless driver, which is adjacent and not the documented ORM/framework support the story asks for. ORM compatibility is a fair axis for a database, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, the database works out of the box with my ORM and framework (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) with documented guides
